chunks: The skies are near to bursting asunder above them, and the angels sing the praises of their Lord, imploring forgiveness for the dwellers of the earth. Is it not that God is forgiving and merciful?
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the angels seeking forgiveness for people on earth?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia tafsir as describing the cosmic reaction to the revelation of the Quran or the presence of the Prophet, highlights the humility of the angels who seek forgiveness for humanity despite their own perfection. It underscores the divine attribute of Rahmah (mercy) as the bridge between the celestial and terrestrial realms, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on the intercessory role of the Ahl al-Bayt and Imams who continue this tradition of seeking forgiveness for the Ummah.
